purpose: Wave 10 Mississippi source-coverage inventory for loaded official county result/review rows, EAC fallback turnout, state-native active-voter denominator leads, OCR-gated county PDF precinct-review feasibility, loaded official historical baselines, county geometry, and administration-context gaps. This inventory records source availability and blockers; it does not promote production data and does not allege fraud or misconduct.

firstReads.developerIndex: docs/developer/index.md was not present in the worktree; absence recorded per wave instructions.

loadedArtifacts.confidenceNotes: Official state-hosted recap CSV is the loaded certified county result and county President-versus-U.S. Senate review source. Rows are county-level advisory inputs, not precinct-level scatterplot rows.
Official statewide results PDF is retained for provenance next to the parsed recap CSV.
Official EAC 2024 V2 fallback turnout rows remain the active Mississippi turnout source until a Mississippi-native ballots-cast or voter-participation package is collected and reconciled.

Official Mississippi SOS November 2024 active-voter denominator lead. It is not loaded as turnout because it has no ballots-cast field and needs denominator timing/reconciliation against an official ballots-cast or voter-participation artifact.

Official county recapitulation PDFs are retained and have an OCR/reconciliation path, but the precinct output is review-gated. Do not import precinct rows until OCR/manual review reconciles all county candidate totals to the official recap CSV.

Official SOS historical county presidential context is now loaded for 2012, 2016, and 2020. The collector downloads/retains source artifacts and asserts row counts plus statewide totals before writing the normalized CSV.
County geometry supports current county map joins. Precinct boundary geometry is not included.
Secondary jurisdiction-level election-administration context only. Do not use as vote, turnout, audit, incident, or proof of precinct-uniform equipment.

sourceFindings.evidence: The reviewed partial OCR path reported 11 import-ready counties, 61 review-required counties, and 10 missing-OCR counties on 2026-06-30.
sourceFindings.caveats: Import-ready partial counties are not enough for statewide precinct advisory coverage. Correction additions can represent reviewed cells that were not present in the checked-in OCR text. Promote only a fully reviewed structured precinct artifact after all county totals reconcile to the official statewide recap CSV.

sourceFindings.evidence: The November 2024 active-voter count normalizes to 82 county rows, 1,980,751 active voters, and a 2,238,135 CVAP estimate.
sourceFindings.caveats: The SOS active-voter report is a denominator lead only. It does not provide ballots-cast, election-level voter participation, or a replacement turnout percentage by itself.

sourceFindings.evidence: The official SOS iframe targets exposed direct historical artifacts: 2020 statewide recap CSV, 2016 statewide recap PDF, and 2012 certified President/Vice President PDF. scripts/collect-ms-historical-baseline.mjs normalizes 246 county rows and reconciles expected statewide totals.
sourceFindings.caveats: Historical baselines are county-level context only, not precinct review rows. They do not resolve the remaining 2024 precinct OCR, turnout replacement, geometry, or administration-context gaps.
